en: Vintage sepia postcard with four photographic views framed by floral decorations. The images show the facade of a brick building, a well-furnished patient room, a staircase with a statue on the landing, and an operating room with medical equipment. Printed German captions label each view, and there is a printed line identifying the place as a private women's clinic. Handwritten German text covers much of the lower-right portion, including a date that appears to be from 1903.
